component.name: CheeseGit
component.summary: A git client for every desktop

description.p: CheeseGit is a free git client that stays fast on large repositories. It covers the everyday work:

ul.li: Stage files or single lines, commit, undo the last commit and discard changes
Unified and side-by-side diffs with syntax highlighting
A history graph with search, branch filtering and commit details
Branches: create, switch, merge and delete, with local changes carried over or left behind
Fetch, pull, push and publish, with SSH and HTTPS prompts
Revert, cherry-pick, stash, and a conflict resolver that works with external merge tools
